title: Bryant's statement after the Achilles injury
source: Sports Illustrated reproducing Kobe Bryant's Facebook post
historical_context: Hours after rupturing his left Achilles while the Lakers were trying to reach the 2013 playoffs, Bryant published a first-person reaction.
why_it_matters: Preserves his immediate uncertainty and resolve before later recovery narratives made the comeback seem inevitable.
verification_note: SI reproduces an extended Facebook post with contemporaneous attribution; the original Facebook permalink has not been recovered, so this is a reproduced primary source.
